newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end mixed, builders and banks recover.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end mixed, builders and banks recover.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended mixed in narrow range trade on Tuesday, with the key stock index closing marginally lower. Early losses were mostly offset by fresh buying and short-covering in sectors that had been hammered recently, such as construction and banking, brokers said.
The key 225-issue Nikkei average finished 8.58 points or 0.04 percent lower at 20,413.46. Its March futures also fell 10 points to end at 20,410.
"Foreign securities houses placed a fairy large amount of buying in banks, such as Daiwa Bank, which triggered more buying," said a trader at a foreign securities house.
